truth_table.name: Cosmetic Glint / Optical Transient
truth_table.description: High visual score from surface reflection, nominal physical sensor, machine running.
truth_table.operational_outcome: Divergence triage to operator review; emergency line lockout prevented.

truth_table.name: Mechanical Structural Defect
truth_table.description: High visual anomaly confirmed by severe vibration and thermal escalation.
truth_table.operational_outcome: Immediate critical line escalation confirmed across both modalities.

truth_table.name: Severe Optical Defocus Blur
truth_table.description: Vibration-induced optical blur, nominal mechanical condition.
truth_table.operational_outcome: Degraded optical fallback; false defect escalation suppressed.

truth_table.name: Optical Blur + Mechanical Fault
truth_table.description: Camera blinded by blur while bearing undergoes severe thermal/vibration failure.
truth_table.operational_outcome: Safety escalation triggered on physical telemetry despite blind camera.

truth_table.name: Sensor Dropout + Optical Defect
truth_table.description: Severe surface fracture while current transducer experiences lead detachment.
truth_table.operational_outcome: Safe degraded fallback without unverified hard shutdown.

truth_table.name: Machine Warmup / Thermal Creep
truth_table.description: Thermal rise during machine startup sequence with clean optical surface.
truth_table.operational_outcome: Operational state gating suppresses startup nuisance warnings.

truth_table.name: Maintenance Inspection Routine
truth_table.description: Technician working on line; elevated visual and vibration telemetry.
truth_table.operational_outcome: Critical alarms suppressed during planned maintenance regime.

truth_table.name: Secondary Exceedance in Cooldown
truth_table.description: Repeat optical and vibration spikes immediately following confirmed escalation.
truth_table.operational_outcome: Redundant alert storm aggregated under existing incident.
